newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria buys 13,000 tonnes raw sugar at $290.
newsitem.headline: Syria buys 13,000 tonnes raw sugar at $290.

text.p: Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foodstuffs (GEZA) has bought 13,000 tonnes of raw sugar, a senior GEZA official said on Saturday.
He told Reuters that the quantity was bought from the Swiss Cargill company at $290 per tonne.
Geza has cancelled the purchase of 13,000 tonnes of white sugar which was contained in the same tender announced on Oct 14, the official said.
